questions.question: You walk into the gym on the first day of school and the basketball team is practising. What do you do?

options.text: Announce that you are a genius and will win everything
Lean on the wall, watch, and say nothing
Ask if there is anything that needs carrying or fixing
Ask the captain straight out what the goal is

questions.question: A teammate cannot get the basics right. What do you do?

options.text: Drill them on dribbling until it sticks
Cheer them on from the sideline
Tell them plainly they are not ready yet
Say nothing and quietly stay late to practise with them

questions.question: It is your day off. Where will you be?

options.text: Asleep, anywhere, for as long as possible
Out with friends, causing a little harmless trouble
Replaying an old match in your head, looking for the turning point
At home with a notebook, planning the next big goal

questions.question: Someone says you are not good enough. You:

options.text: Laugh and tell them they will take it back soon
Train harder in silence and let the results talk
Ask them what exactly you should work on
Feel it, smile anyway, and keep going

questions.question: What kind of best friend do you want?

options.text: One loud enough to make every day an adventure
One steady enough to give you honest advice
One warm enough to cheer for you every time
One clever enough to know when to step back

questions.question: A rival shows up and they are good. How do you react?

options.text: Turn it into a loud contest that lasts all term
Beat them quietly and walk away
Respect them and learn what you can
Keep a close watch so nobody on your side gets hurt

questions.question: Before a big game, you are the one who:

options.text: Gathers everyone and says what you are here to win
Checks every detail, then checks it again
Cracks jokes until the room loosens up
Sits back calmly and trusts the plan

questions.question: Which reputation at school would you pick?

options.text: The strictest and most dependable senior
The mellow friend everyone can count on
The legend nobody can ignore
The sweet one who brightens the room

profile: You walk in like you have already won, and everyone else just needs to catch up.
You are sure you are a genius, and your confidence edges toward arrogance.
You have lost count of the times you were turned down, and you still throw yourself back in.

You would honestly rather sleep than make small talk.
You know exactly who your rival is, and you want to beat them.
You are serious and disciplined, and you dream of taking your whole team to the top.
You look rough on the outside, and you care a lot underneath.
You are known as the best in your area at what you do.
You are sweet and friendly, and you are always there to cheer people on.
You spot talent in others before they have noticed it themselves.
You have a captivating, warm presence that people remember.
You are strong-willed and good-natured, with a little tomboy in you.
You get people ready for the real thing, and you start with the basics.
You know how to sharpen a friend's skills so they hold up when it counts.
You are a brilliant strategist who knows how to turn a game around.
You are charismatic, and you lift people to do more than they thought they could.
You are well loved by the people you lead.
You have been a best friend since childhood, and you are good in a fight.
You are the one in the group who gives real advice when it is needed.
You are happy to be the deputy to the loudest person you know.
You are gentle, empathetic and friendly, a glasses wearer through and through.
You work behind the scenes to bring out the best in a friend's talent.
You are happy to be second in command, the steady one beside the captain.
